notes: Cyril de Rouvre bought a majority in March 1989 and sold to Rafanelli and Cantu weeks later; 1990 is the first full season under them
Euroracing (Pavanello) ran the works chassis from 1983 in place of Autodelta
Footwork (Wataru Ohashi) bought Arrows after the 1989 season; the team was renamed Footwork for 1991
Jackie Oliver and Alan Rees bought back Ohashi's shares at the end of 1995
Tom Walkinshaw bought a controlling stake in March 1996
Malik Ado-Ibrahim's consortium bought a stake at the end of 1998 (60% per grandprix.com, 25% per Wikipedia); Walkinshaw took full control during 1999
Jack Brabham sold his share of Motor Racing Developments to Tauranac at the end of 1970 (source text not checked in the fetch)
Ecclestone bought Motor Racing Developments from Ron Tauranac at the end of 1971
Ecclestone sold the team in 1988 to Alfa Romeo, then Walter Brun, who sold it on to Joachim Luthi; no 1988 entry; Luthi's team raced from 1989
Middlebridge Group gained control for 1990 after Luthi's arrest in mid-1989
Honda bought the remaining stake of BAR in late 2005
Management buyout of Honda's team in March 2009
Mercedes bought Brawn in November 2009
Chipstead Motor Group bought Cooper in April 1965; 1966 is the first full season under it
Benetton bought Toleman for 1986
Renault bought Benetton in March 2000; 2001 is the first full season under it
Genii bought a majority stake in December 2009
Renault bought the team back in December 2015
Minardi merged with BMS Scuderia Italia for 1994; Giancarlo Minardi kept 14.5%
Briatore bought a share in 1995; Rumi was co-owner from 1996/97 to 2000
Stoddart bought Minardi in January 2001
Red Bull bought Minardi in November 2005
Gerhard Berger, who took 50% in February 2006, sold it back to Red Bull (late 2008, undated); the 2006 Berger stake falls in the same season as Red Bull's purchase
Wolf bought 60% of Frank Williams Racing Cars for 1976
A change of control rather than of shareholding: Wolf removed Frank Williams as manager at the end of 1976 and Williams left; the team became Walter Wolf Racing
Dietrich Mateschitz/Red Bull took a 51% majority under a 1994 deal, later 63.25%
Mateschitz sold out after 2001; the stake went to Credit Suisse
BMW bought Sauber in June 2005
BMW sold the team back to Peter Sauber in November 2009
Longbow Finance bought Sauber in July 2016
Thesan Capital bought HRT in July 2011
Comstock bought Venturi's shares in 1992
Cyril de Rouvre bought 21% in mid-1992 and control (69%) in November 1992

Briatore's purchase after de Rouvre's arrest (Dec 1993) was announced in May 1994 (other sources: early 1994), so 1995 is the first full season; Walkinshaw's TWR staff moved in March 1995 and he left March 1996
Prost bought the team in February 1997 and renamed it
Peter Collins and Peter Wright bought Team Lotus in December 1990
Marussia bought a controlling stake in Virgin Racing in November 2010
Fitzpatrick bought the team out of administration in early 2015
Akagi's Leyton House took ownership of the team; renamed for 1990
Leyton House sold the team after Akagi's arrest (September 1991)
Ford bought Stewart in mid-1999
Red Bull bought Jaguar in November 2004
Rumi (Fondmetal) took full control and renamed the team
Midland bought Jordan in January 2005
Spyker bought Midland in September 2006
Vijay Mallya and Michiel Mol bought Spyker in October 2007
Stroll's consortium bought Force India out of administration in August 2018
British American Racing bought Tyrrell in late 1997; Tyrrell raced 1998 under BAR ownership
Dorilton bought Williams in August 2020
